comparison.objective: Hold a PCIe latch released while extracting a graphics card; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual latch depression and straight extraction versus recessed tool use, fine rotation, counterholding, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Latch precedes extraction and card reaches tray without breaking the lock; no damper-cycle measurements.
comparison.reason: Release-before-pull tests constrained disassembly rather than calibration and setting retention.
